recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
recipes.method: Sauté minced garlic in melted butter, toss in the shrimp until pink, then stir in lemon juice and chopped parsley before serving.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Beef Stir-Fry
recipes.method: Sear the beef in hot oil, toss in the broccoli, pour over the teriyaki and soy sauce, and stir-fry until the sauce thickens and the beef is cooked through.

recipes.name: Banana Pancake
recipes.method: Mash the banana, whisk it together with the egg, flour, and milk, then pour batter onto a hot greased skillet and cook until golden brown on both sides.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.method: Arrange alternating slices of mozzarella and tomatoes on a plate, tuck in basil leaves, and drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.method: Place cheese and chicken on half of a tortilla, fold it over, and fry in a lightly oiled skillet until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
